interaction: Configure a ring — metal, centre stone, setting and band width — and the SVG ring redraws with matching metal gradients and a live opal or facet shimmer while a sample price range updates; a circumference-to-size helper feeds your ring size into the design, which then pre-fills the appointment request (demo toast).
notes: Fictional studio; prices are sample ranges and stones are described generically (no grading or certification). Appointment request ends in a demo toast.
